item.title: Founding pastor of Cities Church warns 'Christ or chaos' only choices amid growing hostility
item.description: A pastor who helped plant Cities Church in St. Paul, Minnesota, urged Christians to continue proclaiming the Gospel amid what he discerns as an escalating cultural hostility in the United States, leaving "Christ or chaos" as the only two options. #JoeRigney #TuckerCarlson #CitiesChurch #CREC

item.title: 5 things to know about Trump's Board of Peace
item.description: Here are five things to know about the Board of Peace, which will work to rebuild the war-torn Gaza Strip in the Middle East #DonaldTrump #Israel #Hamas #Davos #Switzerland #MarcoRubio

item.title: Evangelicals decry Egypt's new Easter paid leave policy. Here’s why
item.description: Egypt’s new decree granting Easter paid leave to Christian private-sector workers has drawn condemnation from Evangelical leaders and rights advocates for excluding public employees and dividing holidays by denomination. A legal petition is now pending before the Administrative Court seeking full recognition of Easter Sunday as a national public holiday for all citizens. #EgyptChristians #EasterHoliday #PaidLeave #ChristianProfessionals #Evangelicals #PublicHoliday

item.title: Victory: NHS drops case against Christian nurse accused of ‘misgendering’ pedophile
item.description: A British nurse investigated for “misgendering” a trans-identified paedophile has had the disciplinary case against her dropped. The case was closed by hospital officials after months of internal proceedings and public controversy. #Misgendering #JenniferMelle #Lawsuit #Transgender #Paedophile #NHS #UnitedKingdom

item.title: March for Life attendees praise Trump's pro-life policies, but want more action to end abortion
item.description: March for Life attendees were largely supportive of the Trump administration’s efforts on behalf of the pro-life movement, but said they would like to see more progress as the administration faces criticism from prominent pro-life activists. #Abortion #MarchforLife #AbbyJohnson #DonaldTrump #JDVance

item.title: Trump's week in review: Davos, Greenland and anti-ICE protests
item.description: This week, which marked the end of the first year of President Donald Trump's second term, was dominated by his high-profile trip to the World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, where he made several notable announcements and engagements on the international stage. #DonaldTrump #Davos #Greenland #Minnesota #JDVance

item.title: Armed man fatally shot by ICE agent in Minneapolis
item.description: A man was fatally shot by a Border Patrol agent in Minneapolis on Saturday as DHS law enforcement officers were in the process of apprehending a criminal illegal immigrant as part of a targeted operation. #Minneapolis #ICE #BorderPatrolIllegalimmigration #TimWalz

item.title: This week in Christian history: Henry IV gets absolution after standing barefoot in snow; Pope affirms Council of Trent
item.description: Events that occurred this week in Christian history include the death of an Episcopal Church presiding bishop, Pope Pius IV affirming the Council of Trent and Holy Roman Emperor Henry IV receiving absolution. #pope #CouncilofTrent #EpiscopalChurch #Henry #history #Italy

item.title: DC church sees 2,000% growth as Gen Z, millennials seek answers through faith
item.description: A church in Washington, D.C., says it has seen a 2,000% growth in attendance over the last seven years, a trend that the church’s leaders attribute mostly to Gen Zers and millennials gradually returning to religious life after the COVID-19 lockdowns and, more recently, the shocking assassination of Charlie Kirk. #KingsChurch #churchattendance #spiritualrevival #millennials #GenZ

item.title: 2 Christian nurses acquitted of blasphemy in landmark court ruling
item.description: Two Christian nurses have been acquitted of blasphemy in Pakistan, ending a case that began more than four years ago and forced them into hiding under threat of mob violence. A district court ruled that the prosecution failed to substantiate the charge. #ChristiansinPakistan #bBlasphemyLaw #MobViolence #Lawsuit #Minorities #Quran
